# srallyc: seeds for the SCSP sound board's 68000 (m2sndrecomp --scsp).
# Addresses only, our own analysis (rules.md rule 7). The program dispatches
# through four tables of "jmp (d16,pc)" entries, 4 bytes each; every entry of
# each table is a seed: 0x600884-0x6008c0 (16), 0x601666-0x601862 (128),
# 0x6022c0-0x6022fc (16), 0x60279a-0x6027d6 (16). Found from the 2,207
# addresses MAME's 68000 executed in srallyc_race (M2TRACE_SNDPCS, patch 0004):
# 26 of them lie in these tables, and all 2,207 are covered.
